Package org.cyborgcats.componentViz

Class ComponentViz

java.lang.Object
org.cyborgcats.componentViz.ComponentViz
public class ComponentViz extends Object
Represents a single visualizable robot component, encapsulating its name, 3D pose supplier, optional parent component (for kinematic chaining), and rendering order.

    • ComponentViz

      public ComponentViz(String name, Supplier<Pose3d> pose, ComponentViz parent, int order)
      Constructs a ComponentViz with a parent for kinematic chaining.
      Parameters:
      name - unique display name
      pose - supplier returning the component's local-space pose
      parent - the parent component this pose is expressed relative to
      order - rendering order index used to sort components before logging

    • ComponentViz

      public ComponentViz(String name, Supplier<Pose3d> pose, int order)
      Constructs a root ComponentViz with no parent.
      Parameters:
      name - unique display name
      pose - supplier returning the component's world-space pose
      order - rendering order index used to sort components before logging

  • Method Details

    • tunable

      public static ComponentViz tunable(String name, ComponentViz parent, int order)
      Creates a ComponentViz with a parent whose pose is wired to live NetworkTable-tunable x/y/z/roll/pitch/yaw values, enabling adjustment without redeployment.
      Parameters:
      name - unique display name, also used as the NetworkTable key prefix
      parent - the parent component this pose is expressed relative to
      order - rendering order index used to sort components before logging
      Returns:
      the newly created ComponentViz

    • tunable
